What we collect now

You can browse without an account. Cloudflare delivers and protects the site and may process your IP address, browser details, requested pages and request times for operation and security.

If you email us, we receive your address, your message and anything you attach. Only send what we need to resolve your question. If you send a report, we store the page, offer reference, reason, optional details, report time and our review outcome in a private Supabase database. No email is required. Please do not include payment details, account passwords or other personal information. Cloudflare Turnstile checks report submissions for abuse. A rotating, hashed network identifier limits repeated requests; we do not store raw IP addresses in the report database.

Email alerts: not open yet

The site is not currently accepting subscriber details. When alerts open, we will collect your email address, subscription status and a record of when and how you gave consent. We will use those details to confirm your subscription, send the alerts you requested and honour unsubscribe requests.

Subscription will be optional. You can browse without it. We will update this page and show a collection notice before sign-ups open.

Cookies, saved items and tracking

We do not run advertising pixels, behavioural analytics or tracking cookies. If you save an offer, only its ID is stored in this browser on this device. It is not sent to a server or synced to an account. You can remove saved items using the save button or by clearing browser data. Security services may use cookies or similar checks to prevent abuse. If you install the app, your browser stores its icons and offline notice on your device. Coupon pages and subscriber details are not stored in that offline cache. Retailer websites can use their own tracking once you follow a link; check their policies.

Who handles your details

Access is limited to the operator and service providers needed to run the site or handle your request. Cloudflare provides hosting and security. Spacemail, supplied by Spaceship, provides our contact mailbox. Supabase hosts our offer, report and subscriber databases in Sydney, Australia. Its overseas support and service infrastructure may also process information. Brevo is the planned email delivery provider; no subscriber addresses are collected or sent to Brevo while sign-ups are closed. We do not sell or rent personal information.

These providers may process information outside Australia, including in the United States and other countries where their infrastructure or support teams operate. Information is not guaranteed to stay in Australia. We review provider arrangements before adding new services. We may also disclose information when Australian law requires it.

Security and retention

We use encrypted website connections and restrict access to administrative systems. No online service can promise perfect security. We keep correspondence only while needed to answer you, resolve a dispute or meet legal obligations, then delete or de-identify it. We delete report details 90 days after a report is closed, unless needed to resolve a complaint or meet a legal obligation. Short-lived abuse-control records expire after 48 hours. Consent records and minimal unsubscribe suppression details will be kept while needed to honour your choices. Provider security logs follow the provider's retention settings.

Your choices and complaints

Ask to access, correct or delete information we hold about you by emailing sayvon@fluqon.qpon. We may need enough information to confirm it is your request. If we cannot fulfil it, we will explain why. Asking is free.

Send privacy complaints to the same address. We aim to acknowledge them within 7 days and respond within 30 days. If you are unhappy with our response, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, which can explain whether it can handle your complaint.

Updates

We will update this policy when our practices change and show the date below. Contact us for a copy in another accessible format.

Updated 23 October 2026.

Community contributions — registration closed

When contributor registration opens, sign-in will use Supabase authentication. We use your email to sign you in; it does not enrol you in deal alerts. Your chosen public name, accepted edits, change summaries and sources appear in the offer history. Pending proposals, verification evidence, account identifiers and moderation notes stay restricted.

Choose a public name you are comfortable keeping with your contributions. Do not put personal details in offers or source notes. Accepted attribution and edit history are retained while the contribution remains part of the service; maintainers can suppress private or harmful material. You can request account deletion, correction or removal of personal details through our contact address. Public copies made by others may remain available.

Authentication uses secure session cookies, not advertising cookies. Network abuse limits use a rotating hash rather than a publicly displayed IP address. We restrict account and review access to the people who need it. Before public contributor registration opens, the actual sending provider, retention process and overseas processing arrangements must be checked and reflected here.
